items.title: Darnell Howard Interview, 1957-04-21
items.q: Did you ever see Capone or any of those people? ... Yeah, I went to school with his baby brother.

ctx.x: He was, yeah. He dressed nice. He did. He did. He always looked nice in his clothes. I mean, he was built for it, he wasn't too heavy and tall. He could wear nice clothes. I mean, worrying somebody else would have to go to a tailor shop and, you know, be all old. I think he could just buy them, maybe little alterations and get away like that, because he was built like that. Built on Earl Hines is something like Earl.
Did you ever see Capone or any of those people?
Yeah, I went to school with his baby brother.
